Changelog

JukeCab 0.6.1.4 beta release notes

ADDED - showwhen= support for momentary Search, Page Left/Right, Sort Left/Right and Screen Left/Right actions.
ADDED - matching transient button-state refresh so skin elements can briefly appear when those actions are triggered.
ADDED - support for leftsort / sortleft, rightsort / sortright, leftscreen / screenleft and rightscreen / screenright naming.
 

JukeCab 0.6.1.3 beta release notes

ADDED - dynamic text fills for [textelement]. Supports fixed bitmap, random bitmap, video, and random video fills. Random fills can refresh independently on a timer with crossfades. Works with any dynamic or fixed text (not just Now Playing title/artist). Media is clipped to the actual text glyphs instead of showing as a rectangular background. Existing normal text rendering remains unchanged when textfillmode is not used.

JukeCab 0.6.1.2 beta release notes

ADDED - the ablility to make the random videos change on each song change (refreshon=song). See example usage below.

[skinvideo]
name=song_start
folder=spin
random=true
preventduplicates=true
refreshon=song
x=1181
y=82
width=693
height=332
zindex=6400
visible=true
loop=true
muted=true
autoplay=true
stretch=fill
showwhen=flag7on


JukeCab 0.6.1.1 beta release notes 

ADDED - true Random Title Strips. See example usage below.
ADDED - random videos. See example usage below.
FIXED - Title strip codes, pressing 0 would automatically select any number starting with 0. Now codes like 00, 01. 02, etc can be used.
FIXED - Artist and title in title strips were not honoring width.
ADDED - Select Codes seen on strips did not have fontweight settings like codefontweight=bold. You can now use fontweight with codes.

[titlestrip]
randompaths=Strips\01.png|Strips\02.png|Strips\03.png|Strips\04.png|Strips\05.png|Strips\06.png|Strips\07.png|Strips\08.png

preventduplicates=true
x=1181
y=82
width=693
height=332
zindex=6400
visible=true
loop=true
muted=true
autoplay=true

JukeCab 0.6.1.0 release notes

JukeCab 0.6.1.0 marks the first official online update package for JukeCab. If in the future you do not wish for JukeCab to prompt when there is an update, you can turn off the automatic update check in the Menu under System Tools. You can also check here if there are beta versions to download. Beta versions will not prompt for a download like the main releases but they are available if you want to try them. The version numbers are simple. 0.6.1 is the main release. The trailing zero will increment when it is a beta release. Example below, JukeCab 0.6.0.7 is a beta. JukeCab 0.6.0.0 was a full release.


JukeCab 0.6.0.7 release notes

ADDED - turntable/tonearm playback animations, including loading, playing, paused/idle, and unloading states.
ADDED -animated tonearms that move into position, track song progress, and return naturally on Skip or song end.
ADDED - playback-mechanism video support for load, play, and unload animations.
IMPROVED - song transition timing so skins with animations can complete their visual sequence without unnecessarily delaying normal skins.
ADDED - repeated Skip while a song is still loading, so users do not have to wait for the pending track to start first.
ADDED - per-skin AutoPlay settings.
ADDED - per-skin default Art/Strip browse views for Songs, Albums, Artists, Genres, Decades, Videos, Playlists, and Radio.
ADDED - configurable button-press timing for skin buttons.
IMPROVED - flag-driven skin updates, including conditional text, queue items, and other reactive elements updating immediately.
IMPROVED - skin button/input handling, including better support for independently named [inputregion] controls.
ADDED - shared random bitmap groups, allowing several animated elements to use the same randomly chosen image for a song.
IMPROVED - random-image and album-art transitions, keeping outgoing artwork visible during unload and changing to the incoming artwork at the appropriate loading/playback stage.
ADDED - conditional title-strip styles, allowing strip appearance and colors to change dynamically using showwhen= conditions.
ADDED - conditional strip styling across all browse modes, including Songs, Albums, Artists, Genres, Decades, Videos, Playlists, and Radio.
ADDED - Quinto skin color-theme switching, allowing its title strips and related UI elements to change appearance through the skinâ€™s Flag 1â€“5 selections.
ADDED - (In-Menu Radio settings) Recommended Radio Stations menu with selectable category checkboxes.
ADDED - (In-Menu Radio settings) Select All, Clear All, and persistent category selections between sessions.
ADDED - (In-Menu Radio settings) Import / Refresh Selected to update only the checked radio categories.
ADDED - (In-Menu Radio settings) Download Artwork for Selected Radio Genres to fetch missing artwork for the checked categories. (Artwork still being aquired - about 1/4 finished presently)
ADDED - (In-Menu Radio settings) Re-download Artwork for Selected to force-refresh and replace existing downloaded artwork.
FIXED - Removed Multi-Station Networks from recommended imports because it does not represent individual stations.
ADDED - Live ICY/Shoutcast Now Playing metadata for supported radio streams.



JukeCab 0.6.0.0 release notes

FIXED- Could not back out of search results.
FIXED- Backing out of a mode would drop you at the beginning alphabetically instead of where you began drilling down into the mode.
ADDED- Magic of Christmas Skin conversion. Skin available as a download in skins menu.
ADDED- City-II-1080 Skin conversion. Skin available as a download in skins menu.
ADDED- conditional [inputregion] support using activewhen= so skin buttons can be enabled or disabled based on flags and other UI conditions.
ADDED- reusable Now Playing artwork using [element] type=nowplayingart, allowing multiple independent copies of the current artwork anywhere in a skin.
ADDED- dynamic artwork effects and animation support to media artwork elements, including dynamic position, size, rotation, opacity, scale, tint, glow and blur.
ADDED- CornerRadius clipping support for bitmap and artwork elements, including Now Playing artwork, so square source images can be genuinely clipped to rounded corners.
ADDED- upcoming queue artwork using [element] type=queueart with queueindex=0,1,2, etc. This allows skins to display artwork for songs coming up in the queue.
ADDED- configurable volume thumb sizing and positioning. New settings include volumethumbwidth, volumethumbheight, volumethumboffsetx and volumethumboffsety.
ADDED- per-skin Auto Play persistence. Each skin can now remember whether Auto Play was On or Off when returning to that skin.
CHANGED- startup navigation persistence so JukeCab remembers the top-level mode but no longer reopens into a previously drilled-down Artist, Genre, Decade or Album view after restarting.
CHANGED- drill-down timeout behavior so the existing timeout also applies to intermediate album views, not just the final drill-down screen.
CHANGED- menu wording from â€œFinal Drill Down Timeoutâ€ to â€œDrill Down Timeoutâ€ and â€œFinal Drill Down Timeout Actionâ€ to â€œDrill Down Timeout Actionâ€ to better reflect the expanded behavior.



JukeCab 0.5.9.0 release notes

CHANGED the numbering on the release schedule to better reflect the true release number in the app. 3rd digit will reflect major release while 4th digit will be minor fixes.
ADDED Fast Skin Switching. You can now quickly switch skins without opening the menu by pressing page up and page down. There are also "skinslots" that can be assigned in the appettings.cfg. You will need to set key bindings for each slot you want to use, there are ten slots available. Example usage below.
ADDED 'persistance' to display the last viewed mode when returning to a skin.
ADDED long press now playing art adds the now playing song to favorites. Also works with DO NOT PLAY (see below).
ADDED long press now_playing_title adds the now playing song to favorites. Also works with DO NOT PLAY (see below).
ADDED â€” Default Flag Selection for Flag Groups. Flag groups can now define which flag should automatically be active when a skin loads or when switching to that skin. Example usage below.
ADDED Leading Zero Support for Inline Time Text. So a time like 01:05 will look like that instead of 1:05. Example usage below.
FIXED navigation in menu when mouse hovered over menu, keyboard could not navigate the menu.
FIXED next page not showing in album details view when number of songs in album exactly matched rows visible in first page due to 00 Queue Entire Albumm taking a slot. Now a 16 song album will correctly display a second page in Album Details View in Album Player skin.
FIXED spectrum bitmap from one skin being applied in another when switching skins.
ADDED Do Not Play. Its sort of an anti-favorite. To favorite a song you long press the song. To put a song on do not play, while long pressing the song you press the favorite modifier key which is similar to a shift key. You'll see it favorite the song with a star then while still long pressing the song, press the modifier and you will see the star change to an anti sign (circle with line through it). Currently DO NOT PLAY is only for songs. If there is a need to add albums or artists, we can revisit this.
ADDED DO NOT PLAY auto playlist. Seems counterintuitive to have a playlist with do not play songs, but we need a central place to see what songs have been assigned the do not play list. This seemed the most logical thing to do. 
FIXED Favorite modifier so it can be assigned the same key as an existing key. When a song is long pressed and the modifier key is pushed, the modifier will bypass the main function of the key. The favorite modifier is set in the keyboard mapping menu.
ADDED ability to unbind individual keys in Keyboard Mapping menu. Highlight the input key binding (do not click it, just highlight it) and press delete or backspace to unbind.
ADDED a new secondary skin called CrazyDiamond. Skin uses the "Derm-O-Dyne" style dynamic tint spectrum layers to create a color organ display.

JukeCab 0.5.8.4 release notes

Added and changed skin delivery method. You can now download your skins right from the app. Removed all the example skins from the main app. Downloaded skins will appear in the skin chooser. Skins will be found in the user skins folder. Skins downloaded from https://github.com/jaythom1/JukeCab-Skins You will need a license to use this feature.

Changed - Major refactor of the key bindings. Moved all keys off the num pad so it can be used for number input. Changed a few inputs such as Pause now uses the pause key. Autoplay is now the semicolon which was the former home of pause. Skip song was moved from backspace to the delete key. Now Backspace more logically can be used as a back button. ClearQueue now uses the end key. A fullscreen/window toggle key that was formerly unavailable to be remapped is now using the home key. This refactor is a bit of a change from the legacy Fruitbox key bindings. The new default key bindings are listed below. When upgrading to this version, be sure to go into Keyboard mapping in the menu and at the very bottom of the list, click Reset All Bindings To Default, or if you're brave, delete your appsettings.cfg and let the app rebuild it.

Fixed shuffle songs reverting to sort by artist when autoplay turned on.
Added more flags by request. Flags 0-9 are now available. ALL flags will need to be set in the Menu in Input Settings > Keyboard Button Mapping as flags are no longer set by default. 
Added examples of flags in zzz-Example_Skin_4
Added [flaggroup] flags=0,1,2,3,4, etc to act as toggles for flags. See zzz-Example_Skin_5 for example usage.
Fixed Album art was not displaying in intermediate drill down views.
Added genre tag bottom for dual title strips. Also changed/added naming of tag to genre to better align with what it actually is. Tag still works for existing title strips.
Added Album, year and track number to [titlestrip] styling. These element derived from the ID3 tags. See example skin zzz-IndieGlo_Jr_Example.
Added ability for vumeter to use a bitmap. See example usage below.
Added skin media folders. This allows to load a skin and designate a media folder for that skin to exclusively use. Example usage below.

JukeCab 0.5.8.3 release notes

Added radio to sort settings (shuffle on/off)
Added Radio to the browse view settings in the menu to individually be able to switch between strips or art for radio.
Added blur as a text effect. Example, blur=3. Range of 1-10 available. Useful to match dynamic texts to existing text in a blurry foreground/background image. Search IndiGlo Junior skin for example usage.
Changed IndieGlo Junior slightly to show all modes and to show 	what mode it is currently in (reason for blur effect above) and added some helper messages when no media is loaded.
Changed Random song behavior. Previously, random immediately played song, now in the menu you can keep it like that or change to 'Random enqueues a random song'. Random also now consumes a credit if free play is not on.
Changed -  Major search refactor. Search will now search MP4 tags just like regular MP3s. Added a new row and changed some buttons around. Removed the almost useless Search Decades and added Search Title Year and Search Album Year. Videos are still separate in mode views but may incorporate them in a future release.
Fixed Radio lockout for skin.cfg - added showradiomode=true/false and allowradiomode=true/false as settings.
Fixed code input requiring enter to be pressed in Radio mode.
Fixed Radio Mode not showing the stream data in "now playing" area. 
Fixed issue when an item would become favorited when clicked on directly after a page turn or mode change.
Fixed sort settings in songs mode not being applied after restarting app.
Improvement Re-factored default key bindings for mode views. Modes now use the f3-f10 keys and F11-f12 are previous mode and next mode. This removed the coin 3-6 and flag 1-4 having default bindings using those keys. f1 and f2 are still coin keys by default and all the other coin and flag bindings can still be used, they will just need to manually be assigned from now on. Some more key binding re-shuffling may be in the works but this was the big one that needed to be done.


JukeCab 0.5.8.2 release notes

Added Radio display mode. Uses internet radio urls. There is currently not a designated key assigned so you'll have to set a key in the Input Menu.
Added radio settings in the menu. Ability to add by url, by file, a folder of files, or download the list of Recommended Stations by clicking the Install/Update Recommended Stations section in the Radio Settings. You can also manually edit the stations.cfg in the Radio folder.
Added Disable Load/Unload Sequences setting in Playback Behavior in the menu. This still allows turntable to spin in applicable skins, but gives the ability to turn the load and unload part off.
Added Show Controller Focus on/off in input settings in the menu. This disables the focus selector globally.
Added Library Scan Indicator in Menu when scanning a new media folder. This keeps the app from looking like it is frozen during import. Works during import and during deletion.
Added Legacy Use Left/Right For Menu in the Input Settings Menu. This is useful for jukebox systems that only have left and right navigation buttons. Default setting is Off
Added Open Skin Selector On Startup in the Appearance Menu. This provides legacy skin selector style startup. Default setting is Off
Added Skin Selector Timeout in the Appearance Menu. Timeout will close Skin Selector after 5,10,15,20,30,45,or 60 seconds if no movement is detected. Default setting is Off
IMPROVED mechanical page flip animation to look more realistic.
Fixed sort left and right was ignoring page turn sounds.
Fixed? IndieGlo Classic and possibly other skins - Pause image not disappearing when JukeCab was paused and then page turned then unpaused. Then the image would disappear on next song. I did not actually do anything but the problem went away on new builds.


JukeCab 0.5.8.1 release notes

Added a legal notice when turning off freeplay mode to use credits.
Changed logging temporarily to track a possible spectrum bug.
Added license requirement in preperation to sell the app. 
Added and built out the licensing in the app.


JukeCab 0.5.8.0 release notes

Jukecab now comes with installer. Default setup path is c:\JukeCab.
Added [playbackmechanism]. An all-in-one element to store values for each load, play, unload video for turntable and cd loading sequences. Also holds the idleimage and paused image values. Worked on timing to eliminate any flash to background or other images to the best of my ability. See example below. See Artgrid skin to see it in action.
Added queueplaymode= for allowing the turntable to skip load/unload when more that one song playing/queued. Options are =continuous and =pertrack. Setting is at the bottom of example below.
Added a Library Settings menu page that lets you set where songs and videos harvest there names from. Default setting is Tags with filename fallback. Multiple options available for different scenarios.
Added Diagnostic Logging in the menu with various levels of logging. Logging files save to the Logs folder in the Jukecab folder.
Added menu helper texts at bottom of menu for most menu settings. Probably missed a few.
Added setting to change volume for in-skin events like coindrop, page move sounds, etc.
Added a user skins folder to act as a playground for users to make their own skins. The regular skins can still be edited, but this creates a safe place that will not be overwritten by updates. Added a Basic Default skin in that folder.
Added a Basic Default skin with barebones settings for users to copy to, rename, and edit within the new UserSkins folder.
Added artstretch= to album details. I noticed some of my art that isn't exactly square was being cut off along the edge. Set to artstretch=fill to squish the art to square. The other options are artstretch=uniform, artstretch=uniformtofill, artstretch=none, artstretch=auto.
Moved Sort Settings into the new Library settings menu page.
Fixed search box not very visible on skins with no styling assigned to search. Styling in search probably will be depricated in future.
Fixed stutter in bitmap sequences and scrolling text when mouse would roll across screen. These animations should be much smoother now.
Fixed browse view settings and how they interact with browse views that are locked in skins. 
Improvement: Changed the default settings on several items for brand new installs.

[playbackmechanism]
name=turntable
x=480
y=500
width=320
height=160
zindex=9999
visible=true
stretch=fill
trigger=song,video
unloadon=ended,skip
idleimage=spin/no_disc.png
pausedimage=spin/revolve_01.png
loadvideo=spin/loading_disc.mp4
playvideo=spin/play.mp4
unloadvideo=spin/long_unloading_disc.mp4
loopplayvideo=true
muted=true
autoplay=true
queueplaymode=continuous



JukeCab 0.5.7.9 release notes

Fixed Videos Mode input region logic.
Fixed adding a song after using skip to clear queue and currently playing would not start until skip pressed again.
Fixed issue with timer tick period was too aggressive causing window/fullscreen toggle to not respond.
Adjusted [skinvideo] playbefore, playafter, showwhen to not flash background image during transitions. There will still likely be a small flash between songs, but the load-to-play-to-unload sequence should be a little more fluid without flashing the background image. See artgrid skin for example. That skin was also changed to mp4 instead of sequence of bitmaps for the record spinning. Also added image for pause in that sequence.
Added sort shuffle settings to top level Artists, Genres and Decades. shuffle=yes or no.
Updated MacFarlane Skin
Added IndieGlo Skin - Converted from Fruitbox
Added Frankie Say Relax skin - Converted from Fruitbox



JukeCab 0.5.7.8 release notes

Added the ability to add [albumdetailsbitmap] and [albumdetailstext] styling to album details view. See example usage below.
Added '00 Queue Entire Album' row. See example usage below.
Fixed x-input controller unable to select '00 Queue Entire Album' row.
Fixed artist logo art not parsing names like AC/DC, BjÃ¶rk, CÃ©line Dion, Brooks & Dunn, Bob Marley & The Wailers, etc. This was previously worked on but it did not carry over to artist logos.
Fixed transparent areas of title strips (MacFarlane) were not 'clickable'.

queuealbumrowcode=00

See this release's albumdetailsview in the AlbumPlayer and MacFarlane skins to see it in action. Need to have artist logos populated.



JukeCab 0.5.7.7 release notes

Added ability to add your own m3u or m3u8 playlist. Drop playlist in the \JukeCab\Playlists folder.
Added a playlist import in Playlist Menu. This allows importing existing M3U8, M3U, and PLS playlists into the Playlist Folder via the Playlists Menu, which in turn allows deletion of our copy of playlist while leaving original intact.
Added the ability to add queued items to externally created playlists.
Added a 'Hide Playlist Duplicates' setting in the Playlist settings in the menu. This will hide unintended duplicate entries in a playlist or allow them if a duplicate was intended.
Added Playlist removal 'are you sure yes - no' confirmation message when removing playlist in the menu.
Added PLS format to playlist types.
Fixed entries saving but not being read when queued items added to PLS playlists.
Fixed now playing song was not being added to a playlist when 'Save Current Queue As New Playlist' selected in the menu.



JukeCab 0.5.7.6 release notes

Added Playlist artgrid and Playlist strips styling (see examples below).
Fixed [skinvideo] playbefore=song,video to allow all now playing art and text elements to start with playbefore as opposed to just after playbefore. Example, album art will display when the record load video starts instead of after the record loads.
Fixed Playlist Mode drill down timeout backing out to an empty list.
Improved the new search global vs current mode. Scrapped that altogether and now have buttons above onscreen keyboard in search to better define what we want to search. ALL - SONGS - VIDEOS - SONGS AND VIDEOS next row has ARTISTS - ALBUMS - GENRES - DECADES - PLAYLISTS.

JukeCab 0.5.7.5 release notes

Added pressedscale= settings for strips, (see Woody's Jukebox). Basically makes the strips "pressable" like a button.
Added x-input for controllers and added controller mapping in menu. D-pad moves selection across strips and right stick moves selection across input regions. This may need some tweaking.
Added companion app (Jukecab Volume Analyzer) for normalizing volume in Mp3s, Flac, Mp4s and probably others too but those are the ones I tested. This is a non destructive tool that analyzes your media and builds a database with gain settings for each and every file which JukeCab reads to ensure volume is normalized across the board.
Added volume normalization to the app that reads the database of volume normalized tracks and applies that normalization to JukeCab.
Added in the Menu -> Playback Behavior -> Volume, a volume normalization section to toggle normalization off and on and display current levels. Normalization is also displayed in the Artgrid skin at the bottom of the screen.
Added toggle in search for global results or selected mode results - may need to tweak the verbiage in the future.
Fixed search finding weird results like Die would find blonDIE.
Fixed search to be centered on ALL skins and display the keyboard always when search is opened regardless of skin setting. I plan to have a toggle skin setting to turn the on screen keyboard off in the future.
Fixed segmented artgrid selection not going where expected.
Fixed Strips in playlist mode not going where expected.



JukeCab 0.5.7.4 release notes

Added in-skin video element [skinvideo].
Added playbefore= and playafter= to compliment the showwhen triggers system. Usefule for showing record loading and unloading sequence.
Added Playlist sorting.
Finished converting Woody's Jukebox skin.
Added Playist images - favorites, top played, etc.
